𝐁𝐈𝐍𝐆𝐄 𝗪𝐀𝐓𝐂𝐇𝐄𝐃 𝐎𝐍 𝐑𝐄𝐋𝐄𝐀𝐒𝐄 𝐃𝐀𝐘⁣⁣ 👀 
⁣⁣
For all you Reacher fans out there, the new spin-off 𝐍𝐄𝐀𝐆𝐋𝐄𝐘 takes one of the most popular characters from Reacher and finally gives her the chance to lead her own story. Drawing on her experience with Jack Reacher, Frances Neagley finds herself investigating a dangerous threat while more of her past is revealed along the way.⁣⁣
⁣⁣
Maria Sten proves that 𝐍𝐄𝐀𝐆𝐋𝐄𝐘 can carry a series on her own. There are still clear similarities to Reacher in the action, dialogue and structure, but the focus on Neagley’s background and development gives the spin-off something new to explore.⁣⁣
⁣⁣
Best of all, all eight episodes are available at once, making Neagley PERFECT to binge from beginning to end.⁣⁣
⁣⁣
What are your thoughts on the new “𝐍𝐄𝐀𝐆𝐋𝐄𝐘”? 💭
